Name: Skull Cavern Chest Reset Card
Author: TacNotCat
Description:
[i][AI-translated] English below, Chinese version further down.[/i]
[b]Skull Cavern Chest Reset Card[/b]
Treasure-room chest already looted? Reset it and roll again — as many times as you like.
[b]HOW TO GET ONE[/b]
[list]
[*]Buy it at the [b]desert Casino[/b] for [b]6,666 Qi Coins each[/b], unlimited stock.[/*]
[*]The Casino must be unlocked first by completing "The Mysterious Qi".[/*]
[/list][b]HOW TO USE[/b]
[list]
[*]Hold the card, enter a [b]treasure-room floor of the Skull Cavern[/b], and [b]right-click an already opened (empty) chest[/b].[/*]
[*]The chest closes again and refills with [b]1 vanilla treasure drop[/b] (gems, trinkets, books, etc., from the original treasure-room loot table).[/*]
[*]Each reset consumes [b]1 card[/b]; the same chest can be reset infinitely.[/*]
[/list][b]IMPORTANT[/b]
[b]Note: only right-click a chest after it has been opened to reset it; left-clicking will make the chest disappear.[/b]
If the chest has not been opened yet (still holds its items), right-clicking is refused and no card is consumed.
[b]INSTALL[/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder so that Mods\SkullChestResetCard\manifest.json exists, then launch the game through SMAPI. Name, description and messages follow your game language (English / 简体中文).
[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer (Stardew Valley 1.6.x).
[b]KNOWN ISSUES / NOTES[/b]
[list]
[*]Only works on Skull Cavern treasure-room chests (mine level 121 and below in the desert mine); for Volcano Dungeon chests use the Volcano Chest Reset Card — both mods are safe to install together.[/*]
[*]The card cannot be placed on the ground (placement is blocked).[/*]
[*]Harmony patches Object.placementAction only.[/*]
[*]Uninstalling: spend or drop leftover cards first; no quest or save state is touched.[/*]
[/list][b]骷髅洞穴宝箱重置卡（中文版）[/b]
[list]
[*][b]获取[/b]：沙漠赌场 [b]6,666 齐币/张[/b]，库存无限；需先完成「神秘的齐」解锁赌场。[/*]
[*][b]用法[/b]：手持卡片进入骷髅洞穴宝藏房层，对着[b]已经打开过（空）的宝箱按右键[/b]——宝箱重新关好并重掷 [b]1 件[/b]原版宝藏掉落在箱内，可无限次重置。[/*]
[*][b]注意[/b]：使用重置卡时应在宝箱开启后右键宝箱才可重置，[b]左键会导致宝箱消失[/b]；未开启的宝箱右键会被拒绝且不消耗卡片。[/*]
[*][b]安装[/b]：解压到 Mods 目录，使 Mods\SkullChestResetCard\manifest.json 存在即可。[/*]
[*][b]需求[/b]：SMAPI 4.0.0 及以上（星露谷 1.6.x）。[/*]
[*][b]兼容[/b]：只对骷髅洞穴宝箱生效；火山地牢请用「姜岛宝箱重置卡」，两者可同时安装。[/*]
[/list]
